_comment: The allowed dependency graph and SDK confinement, enforced by
Scripts/check-architecture.sh. SwiftPM's compiler already stops a module
importing what Package.swift does not declare; this file is the other half —
Package.swift cannot gain an edge without a decision.
Adding a key or a value here is an architecture change, so CLAUDE.md rule 2
Two properties worth naming, because they are easy to break by accident:
KamomePersistence depends on nothing internal (the domain does not depend on
the database), and KamomeExportEngine does not depend on KamomePersistence
_confined_comment: An SDK listed here may be imported only under the given path, or under one
of the listed paths: a path ending in / is a directory, any other is one
file, and a listed path that does not exist fails the check, so a rule never
grants a permission to a file nobody wrote. MapKit and Photos are
deliberately NOT here: a CI comment claimed each was confined to one file,
and on 2026-08-31 that was measured false — MapKit is in 3 files and Photos
in 4, all legitimate (a live map view is not the film renderer). The claim
AVFoundation: the video encoder, the soundtrack renderer and the muxer
its own line because AVAudioEngine can be imported without AVFoundation.
_confined_types_comment: `import AVKit` re-exports AVFoundation, so the import rule alone lets a UI
file that plays a film also build a writer (HANDOFF.md trap). Playback in
the UI is legitimate, so AVKit is not banned; instead each type below — or
any type whose name begins with it (AVAssetWriterInput, …) — may appear
only in the listed files. Comments are not counted.
